title: Geometric Series for Matrices and Operators

problemStatement.formal: For T in a complete normed ring with ‖T‖ < 1, prove: (1) ∑ T^n converges, (2) (1-T) is invertible, (3) ∑ T^n = (1-T)⁻¹ (Neumann series).
problemStatement.plain: Generalize the geometric series formula to matrices and operators: the Neumann series ∑ T^n = (1-T)⁻¹ for ‖T‖ < 1 in any complete normed ring.
whyMatters: Foundation of perturbation theory in functional analysis
Operator-theoretic generalization of scalar geometric series
Key tool for iterative methods in numerical linear algebra
